questions.question: How does CSMA/CD detect a collision?

answers.a: By waiting for an acknowledgment signal
answers.b: By continuously monitoring the transmission medium
answers.d: By sending a preemptive jam signal

explanations.a: Incorrect! CSMA/CD does not rely on acknowledgments for collision detection.
explanations.b: Correct! Devices listen to the transmission medium and detect voltage spikes due to collisions.
explanations.c: Incorrect! Token-based systems use token passing, not collision detection.
explanations.d: Incorrect! Jam signals are sent after detecting a collision, not before.

questions.question: Why is CSMA/CD not commonly used in modern Ethernet networks?

answers.a: Because wireless networks are more efficient
answers.b: Because modern Ethernet uses full-duplex communication
answers.c: Because CSMA/CD is not effective at high speeds
answers.d: Because token-ring networks have replaced Ethernet

explanations.a: Incorrect! CSMA/CD is used in wired Ethernet, not wireless networks.
explanations.b: Correct! Full-duplex Ethernet allows simultaneous sending and receiving, eliminating collisions.
explanations.c: Incorrect! High speed does not inherently make CSMA/CD ineffective.
explanations.d: Incorrect! Ethernet remains widely used, and token-ring networks are rare.
